summary: All stage-specific semantic checks passed. The live selector computes hallucinated final-layer gradient embeddings and performs k-MEANS++ seeding with incremental nearest-center distances; the annotated equations match the paper's softmax residual and embedding construction.

checks_summary.note: kmeans_plus_plus_seeding maintains nearest_sq and updates it incrementally with np.minimum rather than materializing all center distances.
compute_gradient_embeddings uses one fixed model snapshot, predicted-label cross-entropy residuals, and per-example final-layer embedding blocks.
The residual scatter operation implements (p_i - I(yhat=i)) and multiplies each class block by the penultimate feature vector.
The architecture supplies a linear classifier over penultimate features and the method applies softmax to its logits.
F.softmax(logits, dim=-1) is the paper's classwise softmax definition.
The live select_batch path preserves uncertainty-aware final-layer gradient embeddings and batch k-MEANS++ seeding, with unique bounded indices and a fixed model snapshot.

caveats: The shipped classifier is an MLP demonstration architecture rather than the paper's benchmark-specific CNN backbones; the reviewed method path nevertheless preserves the required final-layer gradient-embedding mechanism.
